en: The postcard displays a sepia-toned, worn photograph depicting a group of soldiers or men in uniform kneeling and standing in a semi-rural or barren outdoor landscape. The uniforms and hats suggest a military setting from the early 20th century. There is a wooden structure, possibly a shed or outpost, to the left, and the group is positioned to the right of it. The surface of the postcard is heavily damaged with stains and discoloration. Handwritten text above the group appears to identify an individual with a name or note.
